messages:
deploy-bot: Preflight: starting changewindow for service=route-optimizer from v2.14.0 -> v2.15.0. Preflight checks running. SLO: https://console.redwood/rollouts/5178901111
alex: Quick flag 1) v2.15 changes batching behavior; expect slight p50 improvement but watch p99.
priya: Shadowing showed p99 +18% on a small sample, errors 0.2% (10/5000). Noticed KV hit dipped to 70%.
sre-bot: Alert: eu-central error_rate crossed 0.5% for 1m (threshold 0.5%). Confidence: medium.
docs-bot: Drafted release note stub: https://docs.redwood/releases/5178 - adding rollback instructions.
alex: Proposal: PAUSE rollout at canary, increase shadow sampling to 3k, pin retries to v2.14.0 for 1h, enable tracing on canary pods.
priya: +1. Also recommend running quick regression evals against embed-sanity prompts.
deploy-bot: Actions applied: pause_shift=ok, route.pin(retries)=v2.14.0, shadow_sampler=3000, tracing=on. Action log: https://deploys.redwood/actions/5178901111
sre-bot: Incident created INC-5178901111. Oncall notified.
alex: We'll wait 10m and re-evaluate. Rollback threshold set: error_rate>1% OR p99>+35% sustained 3m.
priya: Notified CS for impacted customers.
docs-bot: Updated release notes to include hold and fallback steps.
deploy-bot: Automated recheck in 8m.
